sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Niagara to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to convey such parklands to David Gaines
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Niagara to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to convey such parklands to David Gaines.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending the authorization for hunting big game by rifle in the county of Niagara
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for hunting big game by rifle in the county of Niagara until 2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to disposal of radioactive waste
sponsored.sum: Provides that all waste containing source, byproduct, or special nuclear material shall be hazardous waste.

sponsored.t: Adds Salmon Creek in Monroe County to the definition of inland waterways
sponsored.sum: Adds Salmon Creek in Monroe County to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization.

sponsored.t: Designates the Scajaquada pedestrian bridge as the "9.11 Heroes Bridge"
sponsored.sum: Designates the Scajaquada pedestrian bridge as the "9.11 Heroes Bridge".

sponsored.t: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Civil War veteran John B. Nicholas
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system including the bridge on state route five hundred thirty-one, crossing over route two hundred fifty-nine, otherwise known as, South Union Street, in the town of Ogden, county of Monroe, to Civil War Veteran John B. Nichols.

sponsored.t: Relates to appropriations to the Barker central school district following the cessation of operations of an electric generating facility located within such district
sponsored.sum: Relates to appropriations to the Barker central school district following the cessation of operations of an electric generating facility located within such district; permits awards for a period of ten years for the loss of tax revenue.
sponsored.fis: None to the state as the fund is currently capped at $140 million and this legislation does not lift that cap

sponsored.t: Relates to the tribal-state compact revenue account
sponsored.sum: Relates to monies appropriated and received each year by the state as a portion of the negotiated percentage of the net drop from electronic gaming devices the state receives.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Lemcke Brothers Military Service
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Parma, county of Monroe, to the Lemcke Brothers Military Service.

sponsored.t: Relates to the public campaign finance board and certain matching funds
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the public campaign finance board to accept an application/certification form jointly signed by candidates for governor and lieutenant governor for eligibility to participate in public matching funds.

sponsored.t: Relates to a constitutional right to hunt, trap and fish
sponsored.sum: Relates to the right to hunt, trap and fish; provides for regulation by the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for the recall of a district attorney
sponsored.sum: Provides for the recall of a district attorney.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the legislature from transferring funds from the power authority of the state of New York into the general fund
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the legislature from transferring funds from the power authority of the state of New York into the general fund.
sponsored.fis: NYPA's revenue would not be moved into the general fund.

sponsored.t: Creates a wage tax credit for employers who employ New York national guard members, reservists, volunteer firefighters and EMS personnel
sponsored.sum: Creates a $1,500 wage tax credit for employers who employ New York national guard members, reservists, volunteer firefighters and EMS personnel.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory continuing education requirements for coroners and coroner's deputies
sponsored.sum: Requires a minimum of 30 credit hours of mandatory continuing education every three years for coroners and coroner's deputies.

sponsored.t: Relates to the protection of the health, safety and employment rights of employees suffering employment loss as the result of the sale or closure of a coal electric generation facility
sponsored.sum: Requires certain notices, procedures and approvals prior to the sale or closure of a coal electric generation facility; requires extensive health screening of all employees contractors and subcontractors working at such plant, requires a retraining program for affected employees of mass layoffs.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Unpredictable Nursing Home Inspection Act
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to conduct 40% of its inspections on nursing homes outside of business hours; requires department of health inspections of nursing homes to be conducted without prior notice to a nursing home; requires an annual nursing home inspection report.

sponsored.t: Relates to imposing a nursing home purchase moratorium on those who own or have owned failing facilities
sponsored.sum: Imposes a nursing home purchase moratorium on those who own or have owned failing facilities for twenty-four months since their last violation.

sponsored.t: Provides for establishment of school speed limits by county legislative body
sponsored.sum: Provides for the establishment of school speed limits of not less than fifteen miles per hour by the legislative body of any county or, if so delegated, by the legislative body of any locality within said county on a portion of a state highway, county or town road passing a school building.

sponsored.t: Expands the residential-commercial exemption program to include any municipality regardless of the population of the county in which it is located
sponsored.sum: Expands the residential-commercial exemption program to include any municipality regardless of the population of the county in which it is located.

sponsored.t: Relates to municipal funding for the training of firefighters
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to fund training of firefighters; allows a municipality to recoup the cost of sending a firefighter to training school from another municipality that hires that firefighter within three years of their training.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers and duties of the comptroller to correct certain administrative errors
sponsored.sum: Provides a corrective remedy for certain administrative errors, omissions or inaccuracies relating to membership and benefits under the retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to the encroachment or adverse effect upon military operations by tall energy structures, major renewable energy facilities or wind energy facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the encroachment or adverse effect upon military operations by tall energy structures, major renewable energy facilities or wind energy facilities; requires written determination.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the authorized reimbursement rate paid to governmental entities for enforcement of navigation laws
sponsored.sum: Restores the authorized reimbursement rate paid to governmental entities for enforcement of navigation laws to 75% of authorized expenditures.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminalizing the sale, use and possession of synthetic drugs
sponsored.sum: Criminalizes the sale, use and possession of synthetic drugs; provides various definitions for types of synthetic drugs.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing the maximum age limit for firearms instruction exemptions
sponsored.sum: Relates to removing the maximum age limit for firearms instruction exemptions; removes upper age limits of sixteen and twenty-one.

sponsored.t: Establishes no school shall serve as a polling place
sponsored.sum: Establishes no polling place shall be located on the premises of any public or private elementary or secondary school or a school for preschool children.

sponsored.t: Relates to the reemployment of certain persons ordered to military service
sponsored.sum: Provides a right of reemployment for persons who reside in another state who are ordered to military service within New York state, if the state of residence provides a like protection.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sharing of revenue from gaming devices located within the county of Niagara
sponsored.sum: Provides that $1,600,000 of any funds from gaming devices located within the county of Niagara shall be transferred to the Niagara county industrial development agency for use to fund downtown economic development initiatives within the city of Niagara Falls.
sponsored.fis: $1.6 million to the State, however the SFY 2016-2017 inclUded the same amount for this explicit purpose as a 1-year appropriation.

sponsored.t: Relates to distinctive plates for medal of honor recipients
sponsored.sum: Relates to distinctive plates for medal of honor recipients; removes the word "congressional" from distinctive plates; provides for the reissuance of plates to persons assigned distinctive plates for medal of honor recipients.

sponsored.t: Relates to making expenditures for school safety and security eligible for building aid
sponsored.sum: Provides that expenditures for school safety and security shall be eligible for building aid.

sponsored.t: Relates to free use of state parks and campsites for volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance service
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Provides free use of state parks and campsites for volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance service.

sponsored.t: Relating to local laws restricting farming operations within an agricultural district
sponsored.sum: Provides that the use or storage of manure may not be deemed a public nuisance under local laws restricting farming operations within an agricultural district.

sponsored.t: Relates to information to be reported by registered sex offenders
sponsored.sum: Requires the employment address of certain sex offenders to be reported to the division of criminal justice services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the possession and sale of substances containing heroin
sponsored.sum: Relates to the possession and sale of substances containing heroin in certain weights and packaging.

sponsored.t: Relates to a leave of absence for military spouses
sponsored.sum: Relates to a leave of absence for military spouses; removes the requirement that leave be used when a person's spouse is on leave while deployed to a combat theater or combat zone of operations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the criminal possession of fentanyl
sponsored.sum: Provides that criminal possession of fentanyl is a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing the prohibition on firearm silencers
sponsored.sum: Removes the prohibition on firearm silencers.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the sheriff of any county to issue pistol permits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the sheriff of any county outside the city of New York to issue pistol permits upon the approval of the county clerk.

sponsored.t: Relates to maintaining bridges over the canal system in a manner to not impede commercial motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires that bridges over the canal system be maintained in a manner to not impede commercial motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the village of Lewiston to reduce the speed limit to 25 miles per hour on Center Street
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing the village of Lewiston to reduce the speed limit to 25 miles per hour on Center Street.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated harassment of a police officer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of aggravated harassment of a police officer where a person causes such police officer to come into contact with blood, seminal fluid, urine, feces, or the contents of a toilet bowl, by throwing, tossing or expelling such fluid or material.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Niagara parks reinvestment act"
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Niagara parks reinvestment act"; requires fifty percent of parking revenue generated at state parks in the county of Niagara to be deposited in the Niagara parks reinvestment fund; establishes the Niagara parks reinvestment fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to a sales tax exemption for certain fundraising organized by school-based volunteer organizations
sponsored.sum: Grants a sales and compensating use tax exemption for goods under $2 sold for fundraising organized by school-based volunteer organizations.

sponsored.t: Awards high school diplomas to veterans; repealer
sponsored.sum: Allows any veteran who has served this nation to be awarded a high school degree based on their knowledge and experience gained while in service.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting supervising drivers from acting under the influence of alcohol and/or drugs
sponsored.sum: Enacts Abbagail's law prohibiting supervising drivers from acting under the influence of alcohol and/or drugs and subjects them to criminal charges.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation of live restraint cable devices to take wildlife
sponsored.sum: Regulates the use of live restraint cable devices to take wildlife; authorizes regulations by the department of environmental conservation.

sponsored.t: Provides for a New York power authority trustee from Niagara county
sponsored.sum: Provides that the next appointed trustee of the power authority of New York state shall be from Niagara county and provides for a permanent trustee from such county on such authority.

sponsored.t: Ensures fairness in organ donations to persons with physical or mental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Prevents discrimination against persons with physical or mental disabilities in regards to organ donations.

sponsored.t: Relates to payment by the state of certain costs associated with the psychiatric examination of defendants to determine mental fitness
sponsored.sum: Provides for payment by the state of certain traveling costs and fees associated with the psychiatric examination of defendants to determine mental fitness.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating certain medical providers employed by a municipal police department, while deployed with the special weapons and tactics team, as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to designating certain medical providers employed by a municipal police department, while deployed with the special weapons and tactics team, as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing the local share requirements associated with increasing the age of juvenile jurisdiction
sponsored.sum: Removes the local share requirements associated with increasing the age of juvenile jurisdiction.

sponsored.t: Imposes a one year residency requirement for eligibility for medical assistance
sponsored.sum: Imposes a one year residency requirement for eligibility for medical assistance; authorizes the commissioner of health to promulgate any and all rules and regulations and take any other measures necessary to implement this act.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of profits from commissaries or canteens in county correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Allows county correctional facilities to use the profits from commissaries or canteens within the facilities for the general purposes of the institution.

sponsored.t: Prohibits any sex offender from residing within a quarter mile of any school, playground, park or building in which child day care is provided
sponsored.sum: Prohibits any sex offender from residing within a quarter mile of any school, playground, park or building in which child day care is provided.

sponsored.t: Relates to a leave of absence for veterans on Veterans Day
sponsored.sum: Establishes a leave of absence for veterans on Veterans Day, November 11th.

sponsored.t: Extends tuition free course benefits to volunteer firefighters or volunteer ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Extends tuition free course benefits to volunteer firefighters or voluntary ambulance workers; authorizes the board of trustees of the state university to regulate the conferral of such benefits.

sponsored.t: Prohibits co-pays for certain short term opioid drug prescriptions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits insurance companies from imposing a co-pay pursuant to a follow up visit with a physician in order to receive a refill on an opioid drug prescription which was initially written for seven days or less.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit for farmers who use qualified biodiesel fuel for the sole operation of their farm equipment
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit for farmers who use qualified biodiesel fuel for the sole operation of their farm equipment.

sponsored.t: Relates to disallowing sentences of intermittent imprisonment when the court is imposing a sentence for a sex offense
sponsored.sum: Relates to disallowing sentences of intermittent imprisonment when the court is imposing a sentence for a sex offense.

sponsored.t: Relates to security and protection of New York national guard and air national guard recruiting centers
sponsored.sum: Provides that personnel at New York national guard and air national guard recruiting centers be permitted to carry a firearm.

sponsored.t: Creates a definition of residence under the sex offender registry act
sponsored.sum: Defines residence under the sex offender registry act.

sponsored.t: Relates to eliminating certain surcharges for the licensing of service dogs
sponsored.sum: Allows municipalities to eliminate the surcharge for the licensing of service dogs relating to animal population control efforts.

sponsored.t: Relates to gun license applications not containing warnings
sponsored.sum: Requires that no applications, or the literature given therewith, shall be approved, distributed or used in any capacity if they contain an explicit written warning regarding ownership or use of a firearm.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating every government entity which issues licenses to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms as participating agencies for voter registration form distribution and assistance
sponsored.sum: Relates to designating every government entity which issues licenses to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms as participating agencies for voter registration form distribution and assistance.

sponsored.t: Establishes a credit against income tax for service dogs
sponsored.sum: Establishes a credit against income tax for service dogs.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "red tape reduction act"
sponsored.sum: Requires that new administrative rules that imposes a new administrative burden on a business shall be offset by the repeal of an existing rule.

sponsored.t: Establishes the community college merit and mobility scholarship
sponsored.sum: Establishes the community college merit and mobility scholarship for the purpose of granting merit based scholarships to students who attend a New York state community college; provides for eligibility and awards.
sponsored.fis: Up to $2 million when fully annualized.

sponsored.t: Relates to reading and posting in public schools excerpts of the writings and documents regarding American heritage
sponsored.sum: Requires the regents to promulgate rules to allow and encourage the reading and posting in public schools excerpts of the writings and documents regarding American heritage.

sponsored.t: Relates to county reimbursement for detention costs
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to reimburse counties for costs incurred when holding parolees in detention facilities for technical parole violations pending a hearing with their parole officer.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Lockport to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Lockport to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy; provides the city of Lockport shall notify all owners or known interested parties of record of the placement of the code violations on the city tax levy as uncollected fines and penalties within thirty days of placement.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. To be determined for the City of Lockport.

sponsored.t: Prohibits municipal corporations from adopting local laws, ordinances, regulations, or policies that prohibit certain utility services from being delivered based on the type or source of energy
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the governing board of a municipal corporation from adopting any law, ordinance, regulation or policy that prohibits, or has the effect of prohibiting, the connection or reconnection of a utility service to a customer based upon the type or source of energy to be delivered to the customer.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing valid government issued photo identification when casting a ballot
sponsored.sum: Requires a valid government issued photo identification card be presented when casting a ballot; provides for persons eligible for Medicaid to receive identification cards.

sponsored.t: Repeals the Empire state film production credit and the Empire state film post production credit
sponsored.sum: Repeals the Empire state film production credit and the Empire state film post production credit.
sponsored.fis: $420 million is spent on the Film Tax Credit, and $25 million is spent on the Postproduction Credit.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of person for the purposes of homicide
sponsored.sum: Designates the definition of person for the purposes of homicide as Mya's law.

sponsored.t: Relates to background clearances for prospective employees and volunteers of mentoring programs
sponsored.sum: Permits mentoring programs to conduct background clearances of prospective employees and volunteers to determine whether any such person has been reported for child abuse or maltreatment or is on the sex offender registry.

sponsored.t: Relates to the enforcement of a judgment against certain trust and annuities in the case of minor victims of sexual abuse
sponsored.sum: Permits the enforcement of a judgment against certain trust and annuities in the case of minor victims of sexual abuse.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain requirements of the recruitment incentive and retention program for members of the New York state organized militia
sponsored.sum: Relates to lowering the minimum required course load and permitting application prior to matriculation for the recruitment incentive and retention program for members of the New York state organized militia.

sponsored.t: Establishes a biodiesel grant program for the agricultural production of biodiesel
sponsored.sum: Establishes a biodiesel grant program for the agricultural production of biodiesel fuel; defines biodiesel fuel as a fuel comprised of mono-alkyl esters of long chain fatty acids derived from vegetable oils or animal fats, designated B100, and meeting the requirements of the American Society of Testing and Materials designation of D 6751; establishes the biodiesel grant program fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes March twenty-fifth as "We Care Remembrance Day"
sponsored.sum: Establishes March twenty-fifth as "We Care Remembrance Day".

sponsored.t: Relates to the cost of maintenance and operation of local veterans' service agencies
sponsored.sum: Provides that the state shall cover the cost of maintenance and operation of local veterans' service agencies up to certain set limits.

sponsored.t: Provides grants related to the expansion and support of crisis intervention services and training programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing ten million dollars annually to be used for the provision of grants related to the expansion and support of crisis intervention services and diversion programs.
sponsored.fis: Redirects $10 million in excess Public Safety Communications surcharge revenue towards additional programming for first responder crisis inter- vention training.

sponsored.t: Provides that excess investment tax credit amounts may be refundable to operators of a farm operation
sponsored.sum: Provides that excess investment tax credit amounts may be refundable to operators of a farm operation.

sponsored.t: Requires corporations to provide written notice to the municipality in which the canal is located and properties adjacent to such canal prior to commencing work along such canal
sponsored.sum: Requires corporations to provide written notice to the municipality in which the canal is located and properties adjacent to such canal prior to commencing work along such canal; requires the corporation to hold a public hearing prior to commencing such work; allows for exceptions in certain situations.

sponsored.t: Relates to a plan to address court calendar congestion upon the expiration of the eviction moratorium
sponsored.sum: Directs the chief administrator of the courts to develop a plan to address court calendar congestion upon the expiration of the eviction moratorium including additional temporary space for courts, additional hours, appointing additional judges to handle pending proceedings and coordination with OTDA.

sponsored.t: Relates to emergency intervention for persons impaired by chemical substances
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency intervention services for persons impaired by chemical substances.

sponsored.t: Enacts into law components of legislation relating to the "Military Spouse Act"
sponsored.sum: Permits a military spouse to practice an occupation upon submission of licensure, certification or registration to practice an equivalent occupation issued by any other state; provided the licensure standards are not lower than those of this state.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding two trustees to the power authority to represent Niagara county and St. Lawrence county
sponsored.sum: Adds two trustees to the power authority to represent Niagara county and St. Lawrence county.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the city of Niagara Falls to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Niagara Falls to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. To be determined for the City of Niagara Falls.

sponsored.t: Establishes the power authority of the state of New York shall make low cost hydropower available to certain hospitals
sponsored.sum: Establishes the power authority of the state of New York shall make low cost hydropower available to hospitals and municipal housing authorities located within Niagara county.

sponsored.t: Relates to free use of cabins and cottages located in public places of recreation by veterans
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Provides veterans free use of cabins and cottages located in public places of recreation within the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to decisions by the state board on electric generation; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to decisions by the state board on electric generation; requires approval through public referendum prior to certification for establishing a major electric generating facility.

sponsored.t: Subject to an appropriation for the 2027-2028 state fiscal year, provides that farmers shall receive an exemption from tolls when transporting products to the city of New York for consumption in such city
sponsored.sum: Provides that farmers shall receive an exemption from tolls when transporting products to the city of New York for consumption in such city, subject to an appropriation for the 2027-28 state fiscal year.

sponsored.t: Requires a public referendum to approve a final siting permit
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring approval through public referendum in the municipality in which a major electric generating facility is intended to be located prior to final determination for a final siting permit.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of reckless endangerment of the public health for recklessly transmitting HIV/AIDS
sponsored.sum: Creates crimes of reckless endangerment of public health with respect to HIV/AIDS transmission; creates crime of filing false instrument with respect to HIV/AIDS; provides for HIV/AIDS testing for alleged sex offenders and public health offenders; provides for contagious disease testing for persons in the custody of the department of corrections; provides that if an incarcerated individual tests positive notice shall be given to all employees that will have contact with such incarcerated individual.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting executive orders directing state police to not assist with the enforcement of federal laws
sponsored.sum: Provides that employees of the state police shall not be directed by executive order or regulations to not assist with the enforcement of federal laws.

sponsored.t: Relates to waiving certain fees charged for motor vehicle license plates
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commissioner of motor vehicles shall waive the payment of fees for license plates if the new plates required are due to a change in plate design.

sponsored.t: Requires mandatory health insurance coverage for prosthetic devices
sponsored.sum: Requires mandatory health insurance coverage for prosthetic devices; requires coverage where the model is determined to be medically necessary for rehabilitative and habilitative purposes.

sponsored.t: Allows rifles, shotguns, and firearms on college and university campuses
sponsored.sum: Allows rifles, shotguns, and firearms on college and university campuses.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting private and parochial schools and day care centers from immunization requirements
sponsored.sum: Exempts private and parochial schools and day care centers from immunization requirements.

sponsored.t: Permits concealed carry at state rest and parking areas and scenic overlooks
sponsored.sum: Provides that the department of transportation shall not prohibit concealed carry firearms at state rest and parking areas and scenic overlooks by persons with a valid permit to carry concealed.

sponsored.t: Relates to classroom security devices
sponsored.sum: Requires the installation of panic buttons and additional door security devices in all school classrooms.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of veterans' services to establish and operate an electronic database of the number of openings in each of the 4 state veterans' homes and the number of persons on the waiting lists
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of veterans' services to establish and operate an electronic database of the number of openings in each of the 4 state veterans' homes and the number of persons on the waiting list for each such veterans' home.

sponsored.t: Relates to the state board of parole membership, interviews with incarcerated individuals, and determination of parole
sponsored.sum: Allows for the removal of members of the state board of parole by a majority vote in the senate and the assembly; requires three or more members of such board personally interview potential parolees; requires that the determination to parole an incarcerated individual be unanimous.

sponsored.t: Relates to the priority of persons with responsibility to determine the disposition of human remains
sponsored.sum: Relates to the priority of persons with responsibility to determine the disposition of human remains; provides that persons designated by a member of the military shall have first priority.

sponsored.t: Appoints ad hoc members to the New York state board on electric generation siting and the environment
sponsored.sum: Relates to appointing ad hoc members to the New York state board on electric generation siting and the environment; provides notification of the status of proposed candidates for appointment.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of transportation to study the cost of administering state highway rights of way projects
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of transportation to study the cost of administering utility projects in state highway rights of way.
sponsored.fis: Reduction of revenue to the Department of Transportation offset by increased economic productivity resulting from broadband expansion.

sponsored.t: Relates to a tax deduction for small business employers for certain wages and compensation paid to employees earning minimum wage
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax deduction for small business employers of 25% of the wages, salary or compensation paid to up to ten employees who earn up to 110% of the minimum wage.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual
sponsored.sum: Relates to aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual; eliminates the requirement that an incarcerated individual causes or attempts to cause an employee to come into contact with blood, seminal fluid, urine, feces, saliva, or the contents of a toilet bowl by throwing, tossing or expelling such fluid or material.

sponsored.t: Provides direct reciprocal certification for certain emergency medical technicians
sponsored.sum: Provides direct reciprocal certification for emergency medical technicians who possess a current certification from the national registry of emergency medical technicians.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding two more members to the Niagara Frontier transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Relates to adding two more members to the Niagara Frontier transportation authority.

sponsored.t: Determines that disability compensation or benefits received by veterans from the VA are not to be treated as income or resources for purposes of determining eligibility for means-tested programs
sponsored.sum: Determines that disability compensation or benefits received by veterans from the United States department of veterans affairs are not to be treated as income or resources for purposes of determining eligibility for means-tested programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to purchasing restrictions
sponsored.sum: Relates to purchasing restrictions and persons boycotting American allies.

sponsored.t: Prohibits level two or three sex offenders from voting at a school or facility for children
sponsored.sum: Prohibits level two or three sex offenders from voting at a school or facility for children; authorizes absentee voting for such offenders.

sponsored.t: Requires the use of biodiesel and renewable diesel fuel in state vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of biodiesel and renewable diesel in state diesel operated vehicles; defines biodiesel as renewable, biodegradable, mono alkyl ester combustible liquid fuel derived from agricultural plant oils, animal fats or waste oils and greases.

sponsored.t: Relates to revocation or suspension of a license to carry or possess a firearm
sponsored.sum: Provides that a license to carry or possess a firearm shall be revoked or suspended where a temporary order of protection or an order of protection has been issued, or a temporary order of protection or an order of protection has been willfully violated.

sponsored.t: Establishes the internet media freedom task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the internet media freedom task force to study the practices and policies of social media companies that allow the posting of third-party content by users, as well as other issues relating to dissemination of such content, including but not limited to, forms of censorship employed by social media companies.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain student organizations which are ineligible for funding
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain student organizations which participate in discrimination or intolerance from receiving funding from SUNY, CUNY or community colleges.

sponsored.t: Relates to the distinguishing mark on veterans driver's licenses and non-driver IDs
sponsored.sum: Relates to proof required for application of the distinguishing mark on veterans driver's licenses and non-driver IDs; conforms to federal law including National Guard members and reservists with 20 years of service as veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to granting in-state tuition for community college for individuals who have received letters of acceptance to the military
sponsored.sum: Grants in-state tuition for community college for individuals who have received letters of acceptance to the military.

sponsored.t: Relates to shoreline resiliency infrastructure regulations and tax credits
sponsored.sum: Enacts shoreline resiliency infrastructure regulations providing for preventive measures that could be taken to mitigate the impact of future flooding and provides tax credits for twenty-five percent of the costs of such projects.

sponsored.t: Relates to processing of firearms license applications for victims of domestic abuse who have been issued an order of protection
sponsored.sum: Directs the licensing authority in each county to process firearms license applications for victims of domestic abuse who have been issued an order of protection within 14 days of receiving the application.

sponsored.t: Relates to the testing of newborns for spinal muscular atrophy and public education thereon
sponsored.sum: Requires the testing of newborns for spinal muscular atrophy; requires the department of health to educate the public and distribute informational materials on spinal muscular atrophy.

sponsored.t: Requires a written determination to be made, on each application for issuance or renewal of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver, within 180 days of receipt
sponsored.sum: Requires a written determination to be made, on each application for issuance or renewal of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver, within 180 days of receipt; requires refund of all fees submitted with such application if a determination is not made in a timely manner.

sponsored.t: Relates to qualified firearms instructors
sponsored.sum: Provides that possession and use of a firearm in certain locations under the supervision, guidance and instruction of a qualified firearms instructor shall not be a crime.

sponsored.t: Provides that a license to possess a pistol or revolver shall permit the licensee to carry such weapon concealed
sponsored.sum: Provides that a license to possess a pistol or revolver shall permit the licensee to carry such weapon concealed.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the private employers veterans' preference policy act
sponsored.sum: Permits private employers to adopt a veterans' hiring preference policy.

sponsored.t: Relates to collective bargaining rights to farm laborers, repealing certain provisions of chapter 105 of the laws of 2019 and repealing certain provisions of the labor law and the workers' compensation law
sponsored.sum: Defines certain collective bargaining rights for farm laborers.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding opportunities for veteran-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Expands opportunities for veteran-owned business enterprises.
sponsored.fis: The participation of veteran-owned businesses in NYS public procurements of services, technology, public works and commodities will enhance economic development in New York State and facilitate the success of veteran-owned businesses and the welfare of our Veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to reciprocity for pistol permit applications for military personnel
sponsored.sum: Relates to reciprocity for pistol permit applications for military personnel; expedites application process.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the combination of certain petit larceny charges
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person who has previously been subjected to two or more petit larceny convictions within 18 months immediately preceding the charge and the aggregate value of the property exceeds one thousand dollars, the person is guilty of grand larceny in the fourth degree.

sponsored.t: Eliminates state sales and compensating use tax on motor fuels and diesel motor fuels and authorizes localities to eliminate such taxes; establishes various exemptions from sales and use tax
sponsored.sum: Eliminates state sales and compensating use taxes on motor fuels and diesel motor fuels; authorizes localities to eliminate such taxes at the local level; establishes various exemptions from New York's sales and use tax; provides for a sales tax exemption for housekeeping supplies and for ready-to-eat foods.
sponsored.fis: ò $2.6 billion in annual State Sates Tax savings to New York State consum- ers.

sponsored.t: Allows the immediate family of a member of the armed forces killed in active duty to qualify for the alternate veterans exception
sponsored.sum: Allows the immediate family of a member of the armed forces killed in active duty to qualify for the alternate veterans exemption.

sponsored.t: Relates to expedited teaching licensing by certain military spouses
sponsored.sum: Relates to expedited teaching licensing by certain military spouses that hold a license in good standing in another state.

sponsored.t: Provides for the exemption of disabled veterans of the armed forces of the United States from New York state thruway tolls
sponsored.sum: Provides for the exemption of disabled veterans of the armed forces of the United States from New York State Thruway tolls.

sponsored.t: Enacts Noah's Law; creates the crimes of child abuse, vulnerable elderly person or incompetent or physically disabled person abuse, and torture
sponsored.sum: Creates the crimes of child abuse, vulnerable elderly person or incompetent or physically disabled person abuse, and torture.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the volunteer emergency services mileage reimbursement tax credit
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the volunteer emergency services mileage reimbursement tax credit; allows an active volunteer firefighter or a volunteer ambulance worker a credit equal to their reasonable mileage allowance owed for each mile actually and necessarily traveled by the volunteer firefighter or volunteer ambulance worker who utilizes their personal vehicle in the fulfillment of their emergency response duties.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state local emergency services account
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state local emergency services account; provides reimbursement for expenses incurred related to procurement of any equipment including radio and communication items, apparatus, vehicles including snowmobiles, all terrain vehicles, and boats, goods or services related to the renovation of any buildings, and personal protective equipment.

sponsored.t: Relates to volunteer members of village fire companies
sponsored.sum: Relates to volunteer members of village fire companies.

sponsored.t: Establishes a veterans' dental insurance program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a veterans' dental insurance program through the department of civil service; appropriates funds.

sponsored.t: Creates a volunteer firefighter scholarship program and a volunteer firefighter scholarship fund; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Creates a volunteer firefighter scholarship program and a volunteer firefighter scholarship fund; rewards volunteer firefighters who respond to twenty-five percent of emergency calls for eight years with a student loan award equal to four times the SUNY tuition rate; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing an asbestos remediation tax credit
sponsored.sum: Provides an asbestos remediation tax credit; allows for a twenty percent credit of all eligible costs which are incurred as a result of asbestos remediation, not to exceed $1,000,000.

sponsored.t: Relates to enhanced penalties for certain disaster related crimes during public emergencies
sponsored.sum: Allows for the governor to create a period of enhanced penalties during a disaster; creates enhanced penalties for certain disaster related crimes during public emergencies.

sponsored.t: Exempts compensation for active military service from inclusion in a resident's adjusted gross income
sponsored.sum: Exempts compensation for active military service from inclusion in a resident's adjusted gross income under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Adopts the Physical Therapy Licensure Compact, the Interstate Occupational Therapy Compact, and the Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Interstate Compact
sponsored.sum: Adopts the Physical Therapy Licensure Compact (Part A); adopts the Interstate Occupational Therapy Compact (Part B); adopts the Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Interstate Compact (Part C).

sponsored.t: Relates to burglary on a premises used as a farm operation
sponsored.sum: Includes premises used as a farm operation within the crime of burglary in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Provides a partial exemption from real property taxes for special police officers
sponsored.sum: Provides a partial tax exemption from real property taxes for real property owned by special police officers residing in any county, excluding any county wholly contained in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain restrictions on motor vehicle sales
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain restrictions on motor vehicle sales or use.

sponsored.t: Enacts the psychology interjurisdictional compact, the recognition of emergency medical services personnel licensure interstate compact and the interstate counseling compact
sponsored.sum: Adopts the psychology interjurisdictional compact (Part A); adopts the recognition of emergency medical services personnel licensure interstate compact (Part B); adopts the interstate counseling compact (Part C).

sponsored.t: Enacts the interstate nurse licensure compact and the advanced practice registered nurse compact
sponsored.sum: Adopts the interstate nurse licensure compact (Part A); adopts the advanced practice registered nurse compact (Part B).

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the cosmetology licensure compact
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the cosmetology licensure compact, which establishes requirements and administrative procedures for multistate licensing for the practice of cosmetology.

sponsored.t: Adopts the Interstate Massage Compact
sponsored.sum: Adopts the Interstate Massage Compact to support the mobility of licensed massage therapists by creating an additional licensing pathway to create reciprocity among participant states and reduce the barriers to license portability.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of harassment of a first responder
sponsored.sum: Creates the crime of harassment of a first responder as a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Adopts the PA licensure compact
sponsored.sum: Adopts the PA licensure compact to enhance the portability of a physician assistant license between participating states while safeguarding the safety of patients.

sponsored.t: Adopts the interstate teacher mobility compact
sponsored.sum: Adopts the interstate teacher mobility compact to facilitate the mobility of teachers across member states, with the goal of supporting teachers through new pathways to licensure; establishes a regulatory framework to expedite and enhance the ability of teachers to move across state lines.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state volunteer fire protection emergency reimbursement account
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state volunteer fire protection emergency reimbursement account; provides reimbursement for expenses incurred related to procurement of personal protective equipment and other expenses.
sponsored.fis: None to the State. The current 41% of funds collected from Public Safety Communication Surcharge that are deposited into the State general fund will now be deposited into the New York State Volunteer Fire Protection Reimbursement Account.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purchase of firearms and firearm ammunition with a credit card
sponsored.sum: Requires credit card, debit card, or processor service companies to allow for the purchase of firearms and firearm ammunition with such services.

sponsored.t: Expands the Gold Star exemption
sponsored.sum: Expands the Gold Star exemption by including the War on Terror as a qualifying period of war and allows for the exemption where the Gold Star Parent's child has died in the United States from a service-connected disability.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state commission on regulatory efficiency
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state commission on regulatory efficiency to identify unnecessary and wasteful regulations by the state.

sponsored.t: Lowers the financial burden of professional wrestling promoters; repealer
sponsored.sum: Lowers the financial burden imposed on professional wrestling promoters.

sponsored.t: Allows school districts to opt out of observing any state-designated cultural or religious holiday
sponsored.sum: Allows school districts to opt out of observing any state-designated cultural or religious holiday when less than ten percent of the school population observes such state-designated cultural or religious holiday.

sponsored.t: Prohibits line-item appropriations for organizations engaged in political activities
sponsored.sum: Prohibits line-item appropriations, grants, or disbursements from lump sum appropriations to be directed to organizations engaged in political activities.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 259-j of the executive law relating to the discharging of a person's sentence by the board of parole
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to the discharging of a person's sentence by the board of parole.

sponsored.t: Requires the state comptroller to procure the services of one or more professional services firms to conduct a comprehensive audit of state government programs receiving state funds
sponsored.sum: Requires the state comptroller to procure the services of one or more independent private professional services firms with expertise in accounting, auditing, and fraud detection to conduct a comprehensive audit of state government programs receiving state funds; requires the auditing firm to report fraud, abuse or other unlawful conduct to appropriate law enforcement agencies; requires the audit to be made publicly available.
sponsored.fis: Cost to hire the audit The costs would likely be offset by savings incurred through auditing and identifying waste, fraud and abuse in government programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to dedicating a portion of the state highway system to Specialist Jason Johnston
sponsored.sum: Relates to dedicating a portion of the state highway system to Specialist Jason Johnston.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purposes of the Brockport Exempt Volunteer Firefighters' Benevolent Association, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Changes the name of the Brockport Exempt Volunteer Firemen's Benevolent Association, Inc.; expands the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by such organization.

sponsored.t: Updates the South Lockport Volunteer Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association's charter
sponsored.sum: Updates the South Lockport Volunteer Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association's charter; amends the purposes of such organization and the permitted uses of certain insurance premium taxes collected.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Niagara to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to convey such parklands to Rajendra Sharma
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Niagara to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Niagara to continue to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Niagara to continue to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Amends chapter 530 of the laws of 2024, amending the tax law relating to authorizing an occupancy tax in the village of Medina, in relation to the effectiveness thereof
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the village of Medina to impose an occupancy tax.
sponsored.fis: None to the State. The village of Medina will raise additional revenues if they enact a hotel/motel occupancy tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the building inspector in the town of Pendleton, county of Niagara, to reside outside of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the building inspector in the town of Pendleton, county of Niagara, to reside outside of such town if they reside within such county or an adjoining county.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory continuing education requirements for coroners and coroner's deputies
sponsored.sum: Requires 30 hours of mandatory continuing education every three years for coroners and coroner's deputies.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of sales tax in the county of Orleans
sponsored.sum: Extends the period during which the county of Orleans is authorized to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to Down syndrome diagnosis awareness
sponsored.sum: Relates to including information about Down Syndrome in the health care and wellness education and outreach program; amends the effectiveness thereof.
